15/04/2024 Ms. Sareena Khan, counsel for the appellant.
Shri Atanu Ghosh, Dy.G.A. for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.05/2024 application for temporary suspension of sentence.

Appellant has been convicted by the judgment dated 29 th September, 2021 passed in CIS-Special Sessions Case-47/2019 passed by the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO Act, 2012) Bemetara, C.G. in the following manner with a direction to run all the sentences concurrently:-
U/s 363 of IPC : RI for 1 year and fine of Rs.100, in default of payment of fine, to undergo RI for 3 months.

entities.text: Fast Track Special Court (POCSO Act, 2012) Bemetara, C.G.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: U/s 366 of IPC : RI for 3 years and fine of Rs.200, in default of payment of fine, to undergo RI for 6 months.

U/s 376(2)(j)(n) of IPC : RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.1000, in default of payment of fine, to undergo RI for 3 years.
U/s 376(3) of IPC : RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.1000, in default of payment of fine,
to undergo RI for 3 years.
U/s 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 : RI for 20 years and fine of Rs.1000, in default of payment of fine, to undergo RI for 3 years.
This temporary bail has been prayed for on the ground that marriage of brother of the appellant is going to be solemnized on 19/04/2024.
During the mention, learned State counsel was directed to enquire about the facts.
After enquiry, learned State counsel would submit that the marriage of the brother of the appellant is fixed on 19/04/2024.

Accordingly, I.A. opennyai_summary.decision:
After enquiry, learned State counsel would submit that the marriage of the brother of the appellant is fixed on 19/04/2024.
Considering the fact, we deem it proper to grant grant temporary bail to the appellant for the period from 16 th April, 2024 to 23rd April, 2024 to attend the marriage function of his brother.
Accordingly, I.A. No.05/2024 application for grant of temporary bail is allowed and the appellant is directed to be released on bail for the period from 16th April, 2024 to 23 rd April, 2024 on his executing a personal bond for a sum Rs.25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
He shall surrender positively before the concerned trial court on 24th April, 2024.
